title: land moves the intake drafts in the checkout it runs in aside, as it does for a worker's worktree
goal: backlog.py land, run in a checkout holding untracked kb/_self/backlog/*.json intake drafts (those whose links carry a fingerprint and a detector) and no other change, moves them to _cache/intake-drafts/ of the clone and says so before its clean-tree step, then lands; any other untracked or modified file still stops it at clean tree. Answers the SP-gkbtjjce retrospective: land stopped twice at clean tree because the orchestrator's own SessionStart hook re-filed a drift draft in its checkout, which the orchestrator moved by hand; ST-ocfkanth and ST-bum7owtw cover only worker worktrees.
notes: The check passes before the work on purpose: it is the land e2e test the work extends with a planted main-checkout draft; planning adds the failing assertion's selector or repoints the check before the sprint starts.
